title: Self-supervised learning
reading: A brief outline slide listing the two families of modern self-supervised learning methods: contrastive learning and predictive learning. Neither is elaborated here; they are simply named as the categories to be discussed.

concepts.name: Self-supervised learning
concepts.why_it_matters: Framing topic: learning representations from unlabeled data.

concepts.name: Contrastive learning
concepts.why_it_matters: One of the two main modern SSL approaches, presumably detailed later.

concepts.name: Predictive learning
concepts.why_it_matters: The complementary SSL family to contrastive methods.
